newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria discount, coupon T-bill issues partly sold.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria discount, coupon T-bill issues partly sold.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry offers of two issues of treasury bills, both dated September 4, were only partly sold on Friday, yeilding 200.45 percent and 203.76 percent respectively, the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said.

The BNB issued the paper with a total par of 16 billion levs in a bid to use part of the funds raised at the auctions to cover maturity payments on previous issues due on September 4, a BNB official told Reuters last week.
Three issue of treasury paper with a total principal of some 23.2 billion levs mature on September 4, BNB data shows.
The ministry raised some 5.33 billion levs at the two auctions on Friday, selling paper for around 6.13 billion levs worth.
Eight financial institutions took part in the auction for the first issue, a 49-day discount paper, which was 74 percent sold.
Seven institutions participated in the auction for the second issue, a six-month floater coupon paper, which was 30.2 percent sold.
The second issue was offered with no minimum acceptable price set in advance and its coupon equals the BNB's central interest rate (CIR), now 108 percent, for the period to maturity.
